text: When youapply for a freelance visaor forpermanent residence, you might need a certificate of tax matters (Bescheinigung in Steuersachenorsteuerliche Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung). This document confirms that you paid your taxes on time, and that you don’t owe theFinanzamtmoney.
Request it from theFinanzamt, online or in person. It costs €17.90.1It arrives by post in 1 to 3 weeks.

title: Online
text: Fill theapplication formDownload the form, fill it, print it and sign it. Contact your FinanzamtFind your Finanzamt, thenfind its contact information. Email them and ask for aBescheinigung in Steuersachen. Use myemail template. Pay the application feeFind your Finanzamt’s bank information, and transfer them €17.90. In the payment message, include yourtax ID, your name and “Bescheinigung in Steuersachen”.3 WaitYou will get the document by post in 1 to 3 weeks.2If you don’t get it after 3 weeks, contact theFinanzamt. It’s faster if you phone them. Mine got lost in the mail, so they sent it again.

title: In person
text: You can also get the document if you go to theFinanzamtin person. It might not be faster, because they might still mail it to you.4 Find your FinanzamtFind your Finanzamt, thenfind its address and opening hours. Go to the FinanzamtGo to the Finanzamt without an appointment, and ask for aBescheinigung in Steuersachen. Pay the €17.90fee. WaitYou will get the document by post in 1 to 3 weeks.2
Fill this application form, print it and sign it. You must know yourtax IDorSteuernummer.

title: Email template
text: If you apply online, use this email template, and attach the application form. Generate an email to request a Bescheinigung in Steuersachen from your Finanzamt. This tool requires JavaScript to work.
